plan.disclosure: Defined after the first pass (validation/vanmaanen2_motion.json), whose results were known: not a blind analysis. The first-pass rules and results are kept unchanged for comparison.
plan.frames: stage-1 usability unchanged (diagnostic S/N >= 30, unsaturated, clean core; D6 excluded); fit sigma <= 0.25 px
plan.start_rule: start dependence tested inside one fixed fit window (<= 0.002 px); the RMS shift over the windows that offset starts select is a systematic term (the first-pass rule conflated the two)
plan.systematics: per epoch: first-pass terms + window choice + analysis choice (RMS shift over: constant background, 5x5 and 9x9 windows, ePSF interpolated between zones, catalogued neighbours modelled jointly)
plan.approaches: tied to reference stars (frames with >= 5 references) and untied (archive WCS; frame-WCS term = RMS of this field's tied frame offsets)
plan.budget_validation: tied: reference stars measured in both seasons on one detector (leave-one-out ties), chi2 of their epoch-to-epoch changes after Gaia propagation; untied: the target's zero-displacement pairs (same exposure on two detectors; one detector minutes apart). Each needs p >= 0.0027
plan.pair_status: pass: consistent with the prediction (p >= 0.0027) and p(vs 0) < 5.7e-7 with a validated budget; inconclusive: consistent but below that, or the budget not validated; fail: inconsistent with the prediction (p < 0.0027)
plan.conclusion: recovered if, for at least one approach with a validated budget, the combined D1-D3 pairs give p(vs 0) < 5.7e-7 and p(vs prediction) >= 0.0027, and the detection holds for every analysis variant
plan.not_done: no proper-motion or parallax fit: two epochs per detector give one displacement
